claims.statement: The Mogollon Monster, also called the Arizona Bigfoot, is an ape-like creature reported along the Mogollon Rim in central and eastern Arizona.
claims.statement_id: Mogollon Monster, juga disebut Arizona Bigfoot, adalah makhluk mirip kera yang konon hidup di Arizona tengah dan timur di sepanjang Mogollon Rim.
claims.quote: also known as the Arizona Bigfoot, is an ape-like creature, similar to descriptions of Bigfoot, reported to dwell in central and eastern Arizona along the Mogollon Rim.

claims.statement: It is usually described as a large biped over 7 feet tall with large red eyes.
claims.statement_id: Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai makhluk besar berkaki dua setinggi lebih dari 7 kaki dengan mata merah besar.
claims.quote: The Mogollon Monster is commonly described as a large bipedal creature, over 7 feet (2 m) tall with large, red eyes.

claims.statement: Anecdotal reports say it is nocturnal, omnivorous, territorial and sometimes violent.
claims.statement_id: Menurut laporan anekdot, makhluk ini aktif malam hari, pemakan segala, teritorial, dan kadang ganas.
claims.quote: Anecdotal reports indicate the creature is allegedly nocturnal, omnivorous, territorial and sometimes violent.

claims.statement: Many reports say it gives a blood-curdling scream like a woman in great distress.
claims.statement_id: Dalam banyak laporan, ia mengeluarkan jeritan mengerikan seperti perempuan yang sangat tertekan.
claims.quote: In numerous reports, the monster has been said to emit a "blood-curdling" scream; described as sounding like a woman in "great distress".

claims.statement: Its body is said to be covered with long black or reddish brown hair, except for the chest, face, hands and feet.
claims.statement_id: Tubuhnya konon tertutup rambut panjang hitam atau cokelat kemerahan, kecuali dada, wajah, tangan, dan kaki.
claims.quote: Its body is said to be covered with long black or reddish brown hair, with the exclusion of the chest, face, hands and feet.

claims.statement: Reports claim it has a strong, pungent odor described as that of dead fish, a skunk with bad body odor, decaying peat moss and the musk of a snapping turtle.
claims.statement_id: Laporan menyebut ia berbau tajam dan menyengat, digambarkan seperti ikan mati, sigung yang berbau badan, lumut gambut yang membusuk, dan musk kura-kura buas.
claims.quote: Reports claim it has a strong and pungent odor described as that of "dead fish, a skunk with bad body odor, decaying peat moss and the musk of a snapping turtle".

claims.statement: It is generally reported to mimic birds, coyotes and other wildlife, emit unusual whistle sounds, explore campsites after dark, build nests out of pine needles, twigs and leaves, and hurl stones from hidden locations.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini umumnya dilaporkan meniru burung, coyote, dan satwa liar lain, mengeluarkan siulan aneh, menjelajahi perkemahan setelah gelap, membuat sarang dari daun pinus, ranting, dan dedaunan, serta melempar batu dari tempat yang tersembunyi.
claims.quote: mimic birds, coyotes and other wildlife; emit unusual whistle sounds; explore campsites after dark; build nests out of pine needles, twigs, and leaves; and hurl stones from locations that are hidden from view.

claims.statement: Generally, the scientific community attributes sightings of the creature to either hoaxes or misidentification.
claims.statement_id: Pada umumnya komunitas ilmiah menganggap penampakan makhluk ini sebagai tipuan atau salah kenal.
claims.quote: Generally, the scientific community attributes creature sightings to either hoaxes or misidentification.

claims.statement: The oldest known reported sighting was in the 1903 edition of The Arizona Republican, in which I.W. Stevens described a creature seen near the Grand Canyon.
claims.statement_id: Laporan penampakan tertua yang diketahui terdapat dalam edisi 1903 The Arizona Republican, tempat I.W. Stevens menggambarkan makhluk yang terlihat di dekat Grand Canyon.
claims.quote: The oldest known reported sighting was in the 1903 edition of The Arizona Republican, in which I.W. Stevens described a creature seen near the Grand Canyon

claims.statement: He later stated that after he discovered the creature drinking the blood of two cougars, it threatened him with a club.
claims.statement_id: Ia kemudian menyatakan bahwa setelah ia menemukan makhluk itu sedang meminum darah dua ekor puma, makhluk itu mengancamnya dengan pentungan.
claims.quote: He later stated that after he discovered the creature drinking the blood of two cougars, it threatened him with a club

claims.statement: The first-known report of a mysterious creature living in the area comes from a 1903 newspaper account by a man named I.W. Stevens.
claims.statement_id: Laporan pertama yang diketahui tentang makhluk misterius di kawasan itu berasal dari catatan surat kabar tahun 1903 oleh seorang pria bernama I.W. Stevens.
claims.quote: The first-known report of a mysterious creature living in the area comes from a 1903 newspaper account by a man named I.W. Stevens.

claims.statement: Stevens said the monster gave out an unearthly scream and threatened him with a large club; he also claimed the creature beat two young mountain lions to death and ate them.
claims.statement_id: Stevens mengatakan makhluk itu mengeluarkan jeritan yang tidak wajar dan mengancamnya dengan pentungan besar; ia juga mengaku melihatnya memukuli dua ekor singa gunung muda sampai mati lalu memakannya.
claims.quote: Stevens said the monster gave out an “unearthly” scream and threatened him with a large club. He also claimed the creature beat two young mountain lions to death and ate them.

claims.statement: One story says the monster was once a Native American chief exiled from his tribe, who transformed into a creature that wandered the pine forests seeking revenge for his mistreatment.
claims.statement_id: Menurut satu cerita, makhluk itu dulunya kepala suku Indian Amerika yang diasingkan dari sukunya; sang kepala suku berubah menjadi makhluk yang berkelana di hutan pinus untuk membalas perlakuan buruk padanya.
claims.quote: Another story says the monster was once a Native American chief who was exiled from his tribe. The chief transformed into a creature that wandered the pine forests seeking revenge for his mistreatment.

claims.statement: Although no credible scientific evidence has been found for the monster’s existence, the creature has become engrained in local folklore and has even inspired an annual endurance race in the region.
claims.statement_id: Meski belum ditemukan bukti ilmiah yang kredibel tentang keberadaannya, makhluk ini telah mengakar dalam cerita rakyat setempat dan bahkan mengilhami lomba ketahanan tahunan di daerah itu.
claims.quote: Although no credible scientific evidence has been found for the monster’s existence, the creature has become engrained in local folklore and has even inspired an annual endurance race in the region.

claims.statement: Although almost unknown outside of the Mogollon Rim area, the creature has become part of the local cultural landscape.
claims.statement_id: Meski nyaris tidak dikenal di luar kawasan Mogollon Rim, makhluk ini telah menjadi bagian dari lanskap budaya setempat.
claims.quote: Although almost unknown outside of the Mogollon Rim area, the creature has become part of the local cultural landscape.

claims.statement: It has been the subject of a folk song warning children not to litter and is the namesake of the annual Mogollon Monster 100, a 106-mile endurance race typically held in September.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini menjadi subjek lagu rakyat yang memperingatkan anak-anak agar tidak membuang sampah sembarangan dan menjadi nama lomba ketahanan tahunan Mogollon Monster 100 sepanjang 106 mil yang biasanya digelar pada September.
claims.quote: It has been the subject of a folk song warning children not to litter and is the namesake of the annual Mogollon Monster 100, a 106-mile endurance race typically held in September.
